sources.title: Tiny Aya Water model card
sources.evidence: Exact Water card identifies Cohere/Cohere Labs, tiny-aya-it-water, 3.35B, open weights, CC-BY-NC-4.0, text generation, and European/Asia-Pacific specialization. Public card is readable; model files require accepting access conditions. Reopened October 27: the summary and Model Size both state 3.35B, while Terms of Use contains an inconsistent 111B sentence. The exact specification, original technical report and current metadata consistently support 3.35B; the isolated terms sentence is not accepted as the model size. No active count is stated.

sources.title: Tiny Aya: Bridging Scale and Multilingual Depth
sources.evidence: March 12, 2026 developer report names Water for Asia-Pacific/Europe. Table 1 distinguishes regional language groups. Section 3.1 describes a dense decoder-only Transformer; Table 2 gives 3.35B total, 36 layers and 8192 input/output tokens. Section 5.4 evaluates prompted chain-of-thought, not a dedicated reasoning API. Independently inspected the complete report from the fresh October 27 fetch, including architecture, regional post-training/merging and comparison tables. Table 2 labels 2.8B as non-embedding, 0.5B as embedding and 3.35B as total; it does not define an active count. Regional checkpoints are merged with the global model after post-training; no routed expert expansion is claimed.

sources.title: Tiny Aya documentation
sources.evidence: Exact tiny-aya-water row belongs to the Tiny Aya family, lists 3.35B, and identifies European/Asia-Pacific specialization. Water is an instruction-tuned Chat API variant with downloadable weights.

sources.title: Cohere Labs Launches Tiny Aya, Making Multilingual AI Accessible
sources.evidence: Launch page displays February 17, 2026; its JSON-LD datePublished is 2026-02-17T04:00:07.000-05:00. Embedded article HTML explicitly names TinyAya-Water and its Asia-Pacific/Europe focus. Article body was recovered from the public page HTML because the web text extractor omitted it.

sources.title: Exact Tiny Aya Water repository metadata and chat template
sources.evidence: Public API retrieved directly at repository revision 41a99216d12b3ef4881df762934186e5e4d2bbc1. Exposes Cohere2ForCausalLM, cohere2, base_model tiny-aya-base, license, and one default chat template. Template serializes system/user/assistant/chatbot content; no tools, tool_calls, tool-role handling, thinking branch, or reasoning switch. BF16 aggregate 3349227520 is hosting metadata, not an independently audited learned-tensor count. Fresh October 27 retrieval returns the same revision, 3,349,227,520 BF16 aggregate and named tiny-aya-base relationship. This corroborates the nominal total without supplying active parameters.

sources.evidence: Exact tiny-aya-water row specifies text modality, Chat endpoint, 3.35B, and European/Asia-Pacific specialization. The row does not provide reasoning or tool-support capability flags.

sources.title: Tiny Aya Base model card
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27 the exact base named by Water metadata. The card specifies 3.35B and lists Water as its European/Asia-Pacific chat variant. It provides no active-count definition; named ancestry does not resolve an active count absent from both cards.

sources.title: Building Multilingual Bridges: Data Mixing as the Pillar of Generalization for In-Language Reasoning
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the complete September 2026 report from the fresh October 27 fetch, including section 3.1, parameter terminology and comparison headings. It identifies Tiny Aya Base at 3.35B and compares benchmark performance and generated-token efficiency. No Water/base active-parameter count or dense-count convention is given; later Thinker context and capabilities are not transferred.

sources.title: Multilingual Bridges: How Data Mixing Unlocks In-Language Reasoning
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 read of the October 6 first-party article confirms the later Tiny Aya L2-Thinker at 3.35B and its Tiny Aya Base 32K starting point. It does not report active parameters for Water or its base; inference token efficiency is not a parameter count.

sources.title: How small AI models can make a big impact for enterprises
sources.evidence: Fresh exact-family active-count search found and read this September 2, 2026 comparison. It lists Tiny Aya at 3.35B but explicitly distinguishes total and active only for North Mini Code at 30B/3B. That separate MoE count is not a Tiny Aya active-count convention.

name.note: Exact variant name; distinct from Base, Global, Earth and Fire.

developer.note: Card credits Cohere and Cohere Labs.

family.note: Tiny Aya is explicitly a family of five models including Water; normalized catalog key.

release_date.note: Dated developer launch names Water. Earlier repository creation is not treated as public release; March technical report is later evidence.

open_weights.note: Developer distributes weights subject to access conditions and non-commercial license; gated access does not negate open weights.

license.note: Exact repository license metadata; developer additionally requires its acceptable-use policy.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 exact-card, metadata and original/later developer checks confirm the published nominal 3.35B total. The 3.349227520B Hub aggregate corroborates its rounding; no repeat tensor census is required. The isolated 111B terms sentence conflicts with the exact size specification and independent first-party report and is not adopted.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh exact-model total/active/lineage searches and original/later first-party comparisons found no separately defined active count. Table 2 explicitly calls 2.8B non-embedding; neither that value nor the dense total is copied into active. The named Tiny Aya Base relationship supplies no missing convention, and later Thinker or North Mini Code figures do not establish a Water count.

architecture.note: Dense decoder-only Transformer with parallel blocks, GQA, SwiGLU, and 3:1 sliding-window/full attention; exact metadata identifies Cohere2ForCausalLM.

context_window.note: Table 2 gives exact input context 8192 tokens; replaces catalog decimal 8000. It also lists output context 8192, which is not added to input context.

modalities.note: Exact API row lists Text; card demonstrates text messages and generated text.

reasoning.note: Exact chat template has no dedicated thinking branch; general prompted reasoning evaluations do not establish a native mode. No explicit model/API negative found, so clear unsupported baseline false.

tool_call.note: Exact template omits tool schemas, tool_calls and tool-role serialization. Chat endpoint availability is insufficient to establish native tool support; hosted API capability remains unverified, so clear baseline true.

description.value: Compact multilingual model specialized for European and Asia-Pacific languages
description.note: Matches exact Water positioning; no unsupported benchmark or general-purpose capability claim.

patch.notes: 3.35B is Cohere’s nominal total; active parameters are not separately disclosed. The report’s 2.8B figure excludes embeddings and is not an active count. The released chat template has no native tool or thinking handling; hosted API support for those features remains unverified.

Building Multilingual Bridges: Data Mixing as the Pillar of Generalization for In-Language Reasoning

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit confirms nominal 3.35B and retains an undisclosed active count. Reopened the exact Water/base cards and current metadata, ran fresh count/lineage searches, and inspected the original report and later Thinker and small-model comparisons. Resolved the card’s isolated 111B terms inconsistency against its exact specification and corroborating evidence; did not reinterpret non-embedding 2.8B as active. Added explicit parameter patches and preserved unrelated assessments.
